observation: Read all2703 characters. Stepwise modeling hands age/weight estimates to daily energy intake, then to a deliberately simplified sheep/grass food chain, climate-conditioned pasture demand, assistance/ecosystem levels, and ecological degradation measures. The novel-based diet simplification is explicit, and agribusiness/invasive-species applicability is presented as a possible transfer rather than actual validation. The ending supplies a specific perturbation-to-output comparison (3% source-weight change,5.36% adult-weight and8.98% energy changes), while 'acceptable' has no tolerance criterion stated here. Unlike abstracts ending with a bare sensitivity promise, the source reports an actual response magnitude. Powers/units have been flattened into inline digit strings, so surrounding numeric claims require source text restoration without formula verification. Original spellings such as 'interraction','caroles','mush' are not silently edited. Form fields and a grown-up word break remain unreviewed; no whole-source fidelity accepted.
